action.message:
Implemented the feature contract: wrapped the Changelist `list_editable` POST processing in `changelist_view` with a database transaction.

Change made in `django/contrib/admin/options.py` (the only allowed file):
- In `ModelAdmin.changelist_view`, the loop that saves each changed form (save_form/save_model/save_related/log_change) is now enclosed in `with transaction.atomic(using=router.db_for_write(self.model)):`, so all list_editable edits commit atomically and roll back together on error. `transaction` and `router` were already imported.

Verification: ran scoped_tests — public regression selection `admin_changelist` passed (74 tests, 0 failures, returncode 0).
